The fold law is:

    FOLD_n :=
      G_whole,n
      IF_THEN
      S_internal,n
      IF_THEN
      G_parts,n+1

with:

    G_parts,n+1 = G_whole,n+1

For every n:

    THIS_qua_fold(F_n)
      IF_THEN
    G(F_n, F_n+1)

    NO(G(F_n, F_n+1))
      IF_THEN
    NO(THIS_qua_fold(F_n+1))

Post-element Universe time is the unfolding of admitted configuration genealogy:

    Universe_w
      -> admitted reaction
      -> Universe_w+1

Horizontal reaction:

    rearranges active relations
    preserves the exact element multiset
    preserves K_id_min

### 24.4 JUNCTION_REACTION_ALGEBRA_V1

Purpose:

    derive admissible relations from shape
    materialize horizontal reactions in the fiber
    type every proposed vertical reaction through K_id_min

Inputs:

    ElementBasis
    intrinsic junction ports
    Governed Reaction Lattice
    admissibility predicate
    K_id_min preservation law

Outputs:

    JunctionRelationSetV1
    HorizontalReactionFiberV1
    governed vertical-reaction candidates only when witnessed

Forbidden:

    recipe-table reactions
    automatic vertical edges
    fallback joins or meets
    host-authored compatibility

After promotion, QueueGate SHALL permit bounded candidate writes needed to implement U01 through U10 when:

    parent identities are bound
    target types are fixed
    no authority escalation occurs
    conformance vectors are named
    candidate output remains sandboxed
    effect capabilities remain separate

Codex MUST write missing v3 implementations. Absence of an implementation file is not evidence that the governing law is absent.

Codex MUST stop only on:

    authoritative source contradiction
    exact dependency hash mismatch
    failed constitutive witness

STEP_FABRIC(Σ_t):

  program := Σ_t.program
  snapshot := immutable(Σ_t.state)

  1. SNAPSHOT

  2. EVALUATE
     active_t :=
       { c | payload_state(c,snapshot) = ADMITTED(frame,_) }

     cell_results_t :=
       { c ↦ evaluate(c, program, snapshot)
         FOR EVERY c ∈ active_t }

  3. PROPAGATE
     route_results_t :=
       { r ↦ propagate(r, program, snapshot, cell_results_t)
         FOR EVERY r ∈ program.routes }

     canonicalize route results by route identity

  4. RUNTIME GOVERNANCE
     governance_results_t :=
       govern_runtime(
         program,
         snapshot,
         route_results_t,
         imported_V3_2_authority
       )

  5. SIMULTANEOUS COMMIT
     state_{t+1} :=
       simultaneous_commit(
         snapshot,
         cell_results_t,
         route_results_t,
         governance_results_t
       )

  RETURN (program, state_{t+1})

evaluate(c, program, state_t)

depends only on:
  c
  program
  state_t

and CANNOT observe:
  another cell's current-tick result
  current-tick route results
  current-tick governance results
  partially committed state_{t+1}
```

`evaluate`, `propagate`, and `govern_runtime` MUST be pure deterministic functions of declared immutable inputs.

Only ADMITTED cells are active.

## 6. Input frames

`ADMITTED` carries a complete canonical `InputFrame`.

```text
InputFrame :=
  canonical role-keyed payload structure
  derived from:
    ROLE_SCHEMA(operator)
    JOIN_SIGNATURE(operator,witness)
```

## 7. FRAME_READY / ASSEMBLE_FRAME

```text
ASSEMBLE_FRAME
  → COMPLETE(frame)
  | INCOMPLETE(pending_roles)
  | INVALID(reason)
```

```text
FRAME_READY(c, program, route_results_t)
  iff ASSEMBLE_FRAME(...) = COMPLETE(frame)
```

Rules:
```text
EXACTLY_ONE:
  0 arrivals → INCOMPLETE
  1 arrival  → bind + type-check
  >1         → INVALID(overconnection)

MANY:
  >=1 → canonicalize + type-check

## 8. Partial input custody

```text
PartialInputBuffer := (
  arrived_values : RoleName → Value*,
  tick_of_first_arrival,
  source_receipts
)
```

Partial values live in `pending_input_buffers`, not PayloadState.

MANY inputs canonicalize by deterministic route identity.

## 11. Egress disposition

```text
EgressDisposition :=
    ADMITTED_TO_TARGET(receipt)
  | PENDING_AT_TARGET(candidate_ref)
  | REJECTED_AT_TARGET(reason_receipt)
```

```text
EGRESS_CLOSED(c)
iff EVERY emitted consequence
has a durable committed disposition
```

```text
COMPLETED → DISCHARGED
iff EGRESS_CLOSED
```

Sink cells close vacuously.
